lead.title: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 Sol 'Ultrafast' mode at up to 750 tok/s via Cerebras
lead.summary: OpenAI announced Ultrafast, a new API service tier running GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14x faster than standard inference, reaching 750 output tokens per second on Cerebras hardware. The limited preview targets latency-sensitive enterprise use cases including real-time voice, financial analysis, and customer support.

top_stories.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash is generally available with major agentic coding gains
top_stories.summary: Google DeepMind shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash with strong jumps on agentic benchmarks — DeepSWE 65.3% (up from 49%), FrontierCode 43.6%, AutomationBench 30.4% — and a 50% price discount until end of year.

top_stories.title: Databricks raises $5B at $190B valuation to scale AI data platform
top_stories.summary: Coatue-led $5B strategic growth round at $190B post-money valuation, with Blackstone, MGX, T. Rowe Price, and Sixth Street Growth. The AI data lakehouse company reports $7B ARR growing 80% YoY.

top_stories.title: Arize AI agrees to be acquired by Dynatrace
top_stories.summary: Arize AI, the AI observability pioneer, entered a definitive agreement to be acquired by Dynatrace, creating a ~$14B observability powerhouse as AI monitoring converges with traditional software observability for agents.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 reaches general availability with agentic improvements
top_stories.summary: DeepSeek released the GA version of V4 Pro (0813 build), a 1.6T-parameter MoE with 1M-token context and 384K output tokens. It ranks #2 on SWE-bench Verified at 1/36th the cost of frontier models.

items.title: Reduced Matrix Multiplication: training-free LLM inference speedup
items.summary: RMM selectively reduces Transformer matrix products by identifying and skipping redundant computations, offering a training-free path to faster inference without quality loss.

items.title: Step-level self-distilled policy optimization for deep search agents
items.summary: OPSD addresses sparse reward in multi-step search trajectories by using the model's own logits for step-level credit assignment, enabling more efficient RL for deep search agents.

items.title: How do VLMs behave when blind or misled?
items.summary: A behavioral evaluation of vision-language models under uncertainty, finding that models can internally distinguish when abstention is required but often fail to express it.

items.title: Spatial Memory Agent: experience-grounded memory for spatial intelligence
items.summary: A framework that gives VLM agents procedural memory for spatial reasoning, improving performance on embodied tasks, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants.

items.title: Training AI scientists to replicate research
items.summary: A paper exploring how to train AI systems to independently replicate scientific results, illuminating underspecified details and strengthening the reproducibility pipeline.

items.title: xAI launches Grok 4.6, expanding the AI model landscape
items.summary: xAI released Grok 4.6, the latest version of its flagship LLM, further broadening the competitive model options available to developers and enterprises.

items.title: Grok Bot simplifies AI agent development for mainstream users
items.summary: xAI's new Grok Bot lowers the barrier for building and deploying AI agents, making agentic workflows accessible through natural language configuration.

items.title: LG moves ahead on next-generation walking humanoid robot with Nvidia tech
items.summary: LG announced a bipedal humanoid robot built on NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, with a public unveiling planned for Q1 2027. The companies signed an MOU covering robotics, AI factories, and autonomous vehicles.

items.title: Cerebras shares plunge nearly 20% after missing earnings expectations
items.summary: Cerebras stock dropped nearly 20% after Q2 earnings miss as hardware sales declined, though AI cloud revenue surged 281% YoY. Stock-based compensation jumped from $13.3M to $377M post-IPO.

items.title: Qualcomm details Snapdragon C specs for $300 laptops
items.summary: Qualcomm disclosed specifications for its entry-level Snapdragon C Arm SoC, claiming 67% faster performance on battery than Intel's N250. AC performance figures remain undisclosed.

items.title: Report catalogs over 200 humanoid robot providers worldwide
items.summary: The Robot Report published a free report on mobile manipulators and humanoids, cataloging 200+ verified humanoid providers and analyzing challenges in power management, perception, and world model training.

items.title: UBS expects AMD to strike a foundry deal with Intel
items.summary: UBS analysts predict AMD, Google, Apple, and SpaceX will tap Intel's EMIB-T packaging technology through foundry deals, driven by TSMC capacity constraints. Goldman Sachs expects NVIDIA to ship 10x more racks than AMD in 2026.

items.title: X open-sources its ranking algorithm with shadowban transparency tool
items.summary: X released its 'For You' timeline algorithm and core ranking engine under Apache v2 on GitHub. A new 'Under the Hood' tool lets users download their ranking-impact stats as JSON for AI-assisted analysis.

items.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to embed GPT-5.6 into enterprise security and consulting
items.summary: IBM and OpenAI announced a strategic partnership making OpenAI an Elite partner, integrating GPT-5.6 models into IBM's Autonomous Security platform and enterprise consulting for Fortune 500 deployment.

items.title: Cliclaw — Telegram bridge for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Gemini CLI
items.summary: An open-source Telegram bot that lets developers control Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Pi, and Gemini CLI from their phone. Supports per-chat sessions, confirm gate, streaming output, and image attachments.

items.title: Harness Training — auto-train model-agnostic benchmark harnesses for LLMs
items.summary: An open-source framework that trains a 'harness' to improve model-agnostic capabilities using PyTorch-like APIs, enabling cross-model gains without fine-tuning the underlying LLM.

items.title: Yuno raises $45M Series B for AI-native global payments infrastructure
items.summary: Series B led by Global PayTech Ventures with a16z, Tiger Global, and Gulf sovereign funds. Yuno's AI-native payments OS connects 1,000+ payment methods across markets.

items.title: Mindgard raises $30M Series A to guard AI systems against attacks
items.summary: Series A led by Album VC with Karma Ventures and .406 Ventures. Mindgard's platform provides AI red-teaming and adversarial security for generative AI deployments.

items.title: Pathway AI raises $30M seed at $500M valuation for post-Transformer models
items.summary: Seed round from Id4 Ventures, TQ Ventures, and Red Bridge Ventures. OpenAI-alum founders are building a post-Transformer 'Dragon Hatchling' model architecture.
